ALUMINI
About
Alumni are the enduring strength and voice of any academic institution. They embody the legacy of their alma mater, serving as role models and ambassadors across diverse fields and geographies. Their achievements reflect the quality of education, values, and vision of the college.
The Alumni Association of KU College of Engineering and Technology serves as a vibrant bridge between the past and present, uniting generations of engineers who have passed through our esteemed halls. It fosters a lifelong connection among alumni, faculty, and current students, cultivating a shared commitment to professional growth, social responsibility, and institutional excellence.
The Alumni Association was registered under the name
KUCET ALUMNI ASSOCIATION
(Reg No. 199 of 2021). The association general body comprises of President, Vice-President, Vice-President (Women’s), General Secretary, Joint Secretary, Treasurer and six executive council members. The past election of general body members happened in the year 2021.

Alumni Contribution Areas
Mentorship & Career Guidance:
Organizing sessions where experienced alumni mentor students on career planning, higher education, entrepreneurship, and industry readiness.
Networking & Collaboration:
Hosting alumni meets, webinars, and industry-academia conclaves to strengthen professional networks and foster collaboration.
Student Support & Scholarships:
Offering merit-based or need-based scholarships, funding student projects, or supporting students for conferences and competitions.
Guest Lectures:
Interacting with current students of different graduate levels. Providing them general insights of engineering education.
Placement/Internship Activities:
Throwing light on the importance of internship and providing support to the internship activities. Textured training oriented towards the industry needs and conducting placement drives.
Institutional Development:
Contributing to infrastructural enhancements, lab modernization, or sponsoring technical fests and hackathons.
Curriculum Enrichment:
Recommending curriculum updates based on industry trends or conducting guest lectures and workshops on emerging technologies.
Social Responsibility Initiatives:
Engaging in outreach programs like blood donation camps, environmental awareness drives, and rural development.
Entrepreneurship Ecosystem Support:
Supporting incubation cells, start-up mentorship, or angel investment opportunities for young innovators.
Note:
Alumni members can contact alumni faculty coordinators for any kind of issues.
